decision.function: Financial statement table presenting Liabilities and Equity sections with line items and corresponding numerical values for two reporting periods.
decision.interpretation: Bold label positioned above a contiguous block of liability line items, introducing the liabilities section of the financial statement.

decision.function: Financial statement table presenting Liabilities and Equity sections with line items and corresponding numerical values for two reporting periods.
decision.interpretation: Bold label positioned above a contiguous block of equity line items, introducing the equity section of the financial statement.
